scope: Jun Zhou Google Scholar 2020–2022 abstract follow-up

records.title: Material-Guided Siamese Fusion Network for Hyperspectral Object Tracking
records.abstractSummary: 提出材料引导 Siamese 融合网络 SiamF：按波段重要性将高光谱帧分组为伪彩色图，以 HFF 密集连接模块融合多层、多组特征，并用全局—局部通道注意力及在线空间/材料分类器适应目标变化；摘要报告优于替代跟踪器。

records.title: Learning a Model-Based Deep Hyperspectral Denoiser from a Single Noisy Hyperspectral Image
records.abstractSummary: 提出从单幅噪声高光谱图像学习的模型驱动去噪网络 GMSC-Net：将稀疏表示梯度动量迭代展开为网络，并以局部立方体聚类中心构造噪声—“干净”训练对；合成和真实数据实验均有效。

records.title: Spectral and Spatial Residual Attention Network for Joint Hyperspectral and Lidar Data Classification
records.abstractSummary: 提出光谱与空间残差注意力网络进行高光谱—LiDAR融合分类，以光谱残差注意力和空间残差注意力学习异构特征；在 Houston 数据集上优于对比方法。

records.title: Nonlocal Low-Rank Nonnegative Tensor Factorization for Hyperspectral Unmixing
records.abstractSummary: Hyperspectral unmixing decomposes hyperspectral images into endmembers and abundances. This work extends nonnegative tensor factorization with a non-local low-rank constraint on abundance maps to preserve local/non-local spatial structure and avoid suspicious solutions; tests on synthetic and real data outperform state of the art.
